title: Alex Jordan is making waves with the release of his recent track “Same Old You”
htmlContent:
Hailing from Boston, MA, Alex Jordan is a multitalented rapper and lyrical genius taking over the industry by storm with the release of his recent track "Same Old You," featuring Tony Heartless. The lyrics of his tracks are drawn from all his experiences and feelings, which will connect with audiences across the spectrum.

Alex Jordan, on his recent track "Same Old You," is an incredible work. The way is packed with a heavy emphasis on soulful samples, loads of personal information and insight, a laid-back tone, and a smooth delivery and flow that keeps his ever-growing fans entertained. "Same Old You" is a must-hear and must-feel track for everyone who can relate to the message behind the way.
